lever.selected: V2 claim rule (parameter-free, even-handed): a module-level sign is claimable only when its exact paired sign test reaches two-sided alpha 0.05; sub-resolution modules of either sign are reported UNRESOLVED with withheld sign
lever.pre_outcome_visibility: the rule uses only discordant-pair counts and exact test p-values computed per module; it withholds signs from 4 V1-positive modules as well, so it cannot relabel outcomes

rejected_arms.rule: accept donor conditional iff donor-side 95% normal lower bound of argmax share beats the donor marginal share
rejected_arms.verdict: REJECTED - large donor context counts make almost every conditional 'confident'; confidence is not alignment; CategoryTheory worsens (net -1 to -5)

rejected_arms.rule: accept donor conditional only on strict >50% majority of that context's donor continuations
rejected_arms.verdict: REJECTED - a 16-family action space almost never yields majority continuations; the rule collapses the mechanism to the unigram baseline

lever.backlog_lever_disposition: per-module donor matching: marginal-similarity variant is provably inert for CategoryTheory (its marginal is the closest of all 26 to the pool, JS 0.0265, so restriction returns approximately the full pool); conditional-similarity variant requires the held-out module's own conditionals and breaches the frozen V2.1 leakage barrier - prospective successor only

retest.pooled_note: estimator unchanged; both repair arms data-rejected, so the frozen pooled result is retained rather than tuned

boundary: Post-hoc revival analysis of frozen source-projection artifacts; the V2 claim rule and lever arms were selected after inspecting the V1 failures and require prospective re-freezing before use as endpoints. Source-text projection only: no proof-state, tactic-library, prover-utility, theorem-correctness or scientific-authority claim. Sub-resolution modules stay unclaimed; nothing was relabelled positive. Multiplicity: 20 claims at alpha 0.05 across 26 modules implies ~1.3 expected false claims under a global null; all claims are same-signed positive and the family-level sign test covers the familywise concern.
